suggested_fix: No fix required. The authname copy uses strscpy bounded by sizeof(key.authname). The xdr_reserve_space() result is checked before xdr_encode_opaque() writes to it. Every exit path after a successful idmap_lookup releases the cache reference with cache_put(). The name length check is a WARN_ON_ONCE rather than a BUG_ON, so an oversized name cannot crash the kernel, and the space reserved is based on the actual strlen of the name.
